Dialogue.Page: Mellea: Friends, a new species has come to visit us! Look what I have brought...
Vesca: Mellea! While this is an incredible discovery, but we don't know their intentions. They could've killed you!
Mellea: Worry not, Vesca! I was discreet. They've been left unable to explore our waters. Now look at this technology...
Bouderi: This is beautiful... How does it all work? What is it for? Are we sure we can't talk to them?
Pictus: It could be dangerous - I gather they've come from our planetary neighbour, let them return to whence they came.
Auricula: I suppose that's it then, finally we see what we've all been dreaming of and everyone's too scared to go and say hi! Well, I've got work to do. I suspect you all do too.
